name: Vaultwarden
param_style: Diesel 2 DSL, SQLite backend: ? positional binds (booleans bound as 1/0, .first() binds LIMIT), backtick-quoted identifiers; all SQL generated, none hand-written
schema_source: CREATE statements for the tables the queries use, folded from migrations/sqlite/*/up.sql (final state, no secondary indexes) and checked against src/db/schema.rs; AGPL, so only the needed DDL with attribution
data_scale: scale 1: 2k users, 30 orgs, 300 collections, 80k ciphers (50k personal, 30k org) with ~39k collection links, 2.4k memberships, 4.2k direct grants, 60 groups, 6k folders, 30k folder links, favorites/archives/attachments/sends/devices
visibility_note: ~70k stars; the most-deployed self-hosted Bitwarden server, SQLite is the default backend
interest_note: The /api/sync path: SELECT DISTINCT over up to six LEFT OUTER JOINs with a five-way OR of ownership, access_all, direct-grant and group-grant predicates, plus the CipherSyncData side queries; no secondary indexes in the SQLite schema, so the planner works from PK/UNIQUE autoindexes only.
reach_note: the de-facto self-hosted Bitwarden server; SQLite default
